test_TestEnvs_check_envs: test the TestEnvs.check_envs method to validate MuJoCo gym environments with optional lite mode and seed
test_gym_make_env: test gym.make to instantiate a MuJoCo environment by name and verify initialization
test_env_reset_obs: test env.reset and env.env.get_obs to retrieve the initial observation vector from a MuJoCo environment
test_env_obs_dict_reward: test env.env.get_obs_dict and get_reward_dict to retrieve observation dictionaries and reward breakdowns
test_env_step_infos: test env.env.step with zero actions and env.env.get_env_infos to verify step execution and environment metadata
